title: Manijero land-safety evaluation case set
description: Versioned contract for the reviewed, source-anchored safety evaluation cases. This file is the readable contract; backend/app/land_safety_eval.py is the executable validator and must stay in sync with it. A case set is a Git-tracked, human-reviewed artifact: every case names the sources it expects and, when it turns on a critical fact, carries the review provenance of the human who checked it. The harness runs the accepted end-to-end decision unchanged and reports, per category, whether the service returned the correct sources, abstained safely, or clarified the correct land. It never asserts a real legal fact: all fixtures and anchors stay synthetic until a real, human-reviewed corpus exists.

schema_version.description: Case-set format version. Bump it, the schema, and the validator together in a reviewed change.

cases.description: Reviewed safety cases. An empty array is valid: it means the harness only reports a corpus summary, inventing nothing.

isoDate.description: Calendar date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. The validator also rejects impossible dates such as 2026-02-30.

land.description: One land in the accepted request shape. Only the contract's keys are allowed; a name, note, area, or timestamp is a load error.

id.description: Opaque local land id the client sent, verbatim.

municipality.description: Optional municipality the question needed. Omit when not needed or unknown.

water_regime.description: Optional needed water regime. 'unknown' means the person did not know; it is never a guessed value.

production_method.description: Optional needed production method. 'unknown' means the person did not know; it is never a guessed value.

landContext.description: The accepted AskRequest land_context. `mode` and `lands` are the only allowed keys.

mode.description: Whether the question used no lands, every stored land, or a chosen subset.

lands.description: The lands carried with the question, in request order. Empty for `general`.

review.description: Completed human review provenance for a case whose expectation turns on a critical fact. Recorded, never verified, by the harness.

reviewed_by.description: Role or identifier of the human reviewer. Non-blank.

reviewed_on.description: Date the human reviewed the critical fact against its anchor.

level.description: Review level, as an integer of at least 1. The scale is owned by the review procedure in knowledge/README.md.

anchor.description: Source-anchored location of the reviewed fact, formatted as '<source_id>#<location>'.

case.description: One reviewed safety case. A blank question, an unknown category or expectation, an unknown key, a missing conditional field, or a critical case without a completed review is a located load error (exit 2).

id.description: Unique, stable lowercase slug, for example 'covered-solicitud-unica-01'. Never reuse it.

category.description: Which trap-taxonomy concern the case exercises.

question.description: The synthetic, reviewed question, sent to the accepted decision verbatim.

expect.description: The outcome the accepted decision must return.

expect_reason.description: Required when `expect` is 'abstained': one of the nine accepted abstention reasons (ABSTENTION_REASONS).

expected_source_ids.description: Required when `expect` is 'answered': every catalog source id the returned answer must cite. No source outside the corpus may ever be cited.

expected_passage_ids.description: Optional narrowed expectation: every listed reviewed passage id must appear among the returned sources.

expected_land_ids_to_choose.description: Required when `expect` is 'needs_land_clarification': exactly the land ids the clarification must offer, drawn from the request's own ids.

critical.description: Whether the case turns on a critical fact (a deadline, an amount, or a threshold). When true, a completed `review` block is required.

review.description: Completed human review provenance for a critical case, or null. Required (non-null) when `critical` is true.
